entry_item.definition: [= siγa-, 2] a) v. t. To press, squeeze, squash; to strain (by squeezing); to crowd; to oppress; to urge, force something upon somebody, to fatten for slaughter b) v. i. To approach, draw near.

entry_item.definition: beinahe erreichen, nahe daran seyn, nicht viel mehr fehlen; ausdrücken (den Eiter aus ein Wunde}; durchseihen.
To press (e.g. pus from a wound). To press, to throng, to push against, to squeeze, to push forward. To choke. Near at the hand, nearly (arrived, reached or attained)
〔动〕①压，挤，榨；堵：~н зайлуулах 排挤；②快来到，临近，迫近：баяр шахаж байна 节日快到了；③催肥；④逼迫，威道，压迫：~н хүлээлгэх бодлого 强制政策；⑤〈体〉推举；（摔跤时）压.
